## Label fix 2

Under WAC 246-841A the role is the Program Director, who must be an RN, Rename the column and the role.

## License verification 3

Each license is checked on the WA DOH Provider Credential Search and the date is stored. The current test rows use the same license number (RN.60123456.WA) for five people — replace with real records.

## Expiry alerts

Admin and the Program Director get alerts 60 and 30 days before a license expires. An expired instructor cannot sign skills or clinical hours.

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## Pending record

A pending instructor (the live LMS has two such records). "Verify & approve" opens the DOH lookup and records the verification date.

## Label fix

Rename "Director of Nursing" to "Program Director (RN)" to match the WAC wording.

## Verification

Replace the duplicated test license numbers. Only verified, current RNs can sign check-offs or clinical hours.
